points.reason: The classifier derives zero, infinity, denormal and NaN information from operand bits; changing or observing those classifications affects later operation behavior.

points.reason: Operand exponent, mantissa, sign and class data determine the add/subtract result and sign, so corruption changes the operand-derived result.

points.reached by: control_engine_fsm carries fpu_operands.rs1, fpu_operands.rs2 and their classifications into multiplier_core.
points.reason: The multiplier loads operand mantissas and derives the product sign and exponent from the captured operands.

points.reached by: control_engine_fsm carries captured operand values and classifications into float_comparator.
